newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary grain harvest to begin around June 20.
newsitem.headline: Hungary grain harvest to begin around June 20.

text.p: Hungary's grain harvest is expected to start around June 20 and will end in mid-August, weather permitting, the agriculture ministry said on Monday

"Harvesting will probably start within a week and we expect it to end by the middle of August if conditions are normal," Fulop Benedek, State Secretary at the Agriculture Ministry told a news conference.
He added that Hungary had between 8,500 and 9,000 combines, but two-thirds of those were more than five years old and some were in a state of disrepair.
Only 65 to 70 percent of combine capacity could be used.
The ministry earlier forecast a five million tonne wheat crop, up from last year's 3.9 million tonnes, and a 1.2 million tonnes barley crop, up from last year's 930,000 tonnes.
